description:
Stardom is a 43-metre tri-deck superyacht based in Dubai, designed for guests who want more than a cruise: generous decks, a refined interior and the space to host up to 100 guests for a celebration or a corporate event.

The main deck opens onto a large aft deck with lounge and dining areas, followed by a bright saloon. Upstairs, the sky lounge and the flybridge with its bar look out over Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah and Ain Dubai.

Five cabins allow guests to rest during longer charters. A crew of 15 looks after the yacht and her guests from boarding to return.

Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
